Reading the YoY numbers: FY2025 figures reflect the full calendar year. FY2026 figures are year-to-date through the most recent data pull — not a full year. Any YoY % comparison here is therefore full-year vs. partial-year and will read artificially negative purely from the calendar, not necessarily from execution. Use the New / Active / Lapsed buyer flags and % Activated for the cleanest read on rep execution; treat the dollar YoY column as directional until we're comparing full year to full year (or a same-period YTD once we have a 2025 YTD cut).

Rep Performance Summary

What do these columns mean?
Assigned Accts
Every account on this rep's 2026 book, per the assignment list — regardless of whether they've ever bought wine & spirits.
Activated FY26
Of those assigned accounts, how many have bought at least one W&S item so far in FY26.
% Activated
Activated FY26 ÷ Assigned Accts. The share of the rep's full book that's currently buying W&S.
New Buyers
Accounts that bought W&S in FY26 but did NOT buy any in FY25 — brand new to the category this year.
Lapsed
Accounts that bought W&S in FY25 but have not bought anything yet in FY26 — at risk of being lost.
Never Bought
Accounts assigned to this rep that have never purchased a single wine or spirits item in FY25 or FY26 — zero placements, zero buyers. This is the white-space opportunity list.
% Never Bought
Never Bought ÷ Assigned Accts. The share of the rep's book that's completely untapped for W&S.
FY25 $Vol
Total wine & spirits dollar sales for the full 2025 calendar year.
FY26 $Vol (YTD)
Total wine & spirits dollar sales so far in 2026. This is year-to-date, not a full year, so it will naturally be smaller than FY25.
YoY %
% change from FY25 $Vol to FY26 $Vol. Because FY25 is a full year and FY26 is only YTD, this will read negative even for a rep who's pacing fine — use it directionally, not as a final verdict.

Account-Level Detail

What do these columns mean?
Channel
On Premise = bars, restaurants, hotels (drink on site). Off Premise = liquor/retail stores (take home).
Status: Active
Bought W&S in both FY25 and FY26.
Status: New
Bought W&S in FY26 but had no FY25 purchases — a brand-new W&S buyer this year.
Status: Lapsed
Bought W&S in FY25 but hasn't bought anything yet in FY26 — a buyer we're losing.
Status: Never Bought
Assigned to a rep but has never purchased any W&S item, in FY25 or FY26 — zero placements, zero buyers. City/route are often "Unknown" for these since they've never generated a W&S transaction to pull that detail from.
FY25 $Vol / FY26 $Vol (YTD)
Total W&S dollar sales at this account for the full FY2025 year vs. FY2026 so far (year-to-date).
YoY %
% change from FY25 to FY26 $Vol. Since FY26 is YTD only, this reads negative by default even for accounts pacing normally.
Brands (FY26)
Which brand families this account has actually purchased so far this year — use this to spot placement gaps.

Brand Family Performance by Rep

What do these columns mean?
Buyers FY25 / FY26
The number of distinct accounts that purchased this brand family during that year, for that rep.
New Buyers
Accounts buying this brand family in FY26 that didn't buy it in FY25 — new placements.
Lost Buyers
Accounts that bought this brand family in FY25 but have not bought it in FY26 — dropped placements.
FY25 $Vol / FY26 $Vol (YTD)
Total dollar sales of this brand family for the full FY2025 year vs. FY2026 so far (year-to-date).
YoY %
% change from FY25 to FY26 $Vol. FY26 is YTD only, so this reads negative by default — use directionally.

Performance by City

What do these columns mean?
Assigned Accts
Accounts in this city, on this rep's book, per the 2026 assignment list.
Activated FY26
Of those assigned accounts in this city, how many have bought W&S so far in FY26.
% Activated
Activated FY26 ÷ Assigned Accts for this city. Share of the local book currently buying.
Never Bought
Assigned accounts in this city that have never purchased any W&S item, in FY25 or FY26.
FY25 $Vol / FY26 $Vol (YTD)
Total W&S dollar sales in this city for the full FY2025 year vs. FY2026 so far (year-to-date).
YoY %
% change from FY25 to FY26 $Vol. FY26 is YTD only, so this reads negative by default — use directionally.

Note: accounts that have never bought W&S and have no known city (never appeared on a W&S transaction) aren't included in this city rollup — see the By Account tab, filtered to "Never Bought," for the complete list.

How Par Level is calculated: For each brand family, Par Level = the company-wide average number of buying accounts per rep (FY26 YTD), counting every rep — including reps who currently sell zero of that brand. A rep at or above Par is performing at or better than the average rep on that brand; below Par means they're carrying fewer buying accounts on that brand than their peers typically do. Because a few high-volume reps can pull the average up, Par Level is a moving target, not a fixed goal — and it's based on FY26 year-to-date data, so it will shift as the year goes on.

Par Level by Brand Family (Company-Wide)

What do these columns mean?
Par Level
The average number of buying accounts per rep for this brand family, across all 31 reps company-wide (FY26 YTD), including reps who sell zero of it. This is the bar every rep is measured against on this brand.

Rep × Brand Detail

What do these columns mean?
Current Buyers (FY26)
How many of this rep's accounts are currently buying this brand family, so far this year.
Par Level
The company average buyers/rep for this brand (see table above) — the baseline this rep is compared against.
Gap
Current Buyers minus Par Level. Positive means ahead of the average rep on this brand; negative means behind.
Status
At/Above Par = performing at or better than the average rep on this brand. Below Par = carrying fewer buying accounts on this brand than average.
